cases.name: Tara Danielle Ord Sidarovich
cases.about:
She wanted to study to become a crime scene investigator. 

She worked at the Golden Isle Jewelry store. Her mother Sharon McPhillips said, “I just want the court to know a beautiful, vibrant, young, smart woman ... was taken from us very violently,” McPhillips said. “She had dreams; she had a future that was taken. I have three grand babies who have never met her. ...This has impacted our lives every day.”

https://www.news-press.com/story/news/2015/10/28/barr-gets-life-sidarovich-slaying/74762062/
cases.narrative: On 7/12/2002, her skeletal remains were found in a wooded area east of Burnt Store Road in Charlotte County. She was killed by blunt force trauma to the chest and had four broken ribs.
